record.rationale: React DOM platform code binds existing canonical source model/view and shared Sfx contracts;it does not claim to translate a native VCL implementation file.
responsibilities: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity.

TaskFJTKAS connects actual Calc ODS packages and ScDocShell lifecycle/history to shared primary browser storage and Writer autosave policy. Open imports into a separate real ScDocument and adopts it only while request/content generation remain current. Replacement resets actual view/history ownership and ends displaced formula subscriptions. Confirmed Save/SaveAs captures source model,medium,generation and shared SfxUndoSavePosition;later edits remain dirty and stale/failed/closed completions cannot adopt a destination. The first two displayed scalar words in native row-major sheet order name an untitled browser document,matching Writer first-two-word naming;empty documents are excluded. Stored bodies are complete existing ODS packages,not alternate workbook JSON. No recovery UI/storage is introduced.

TaskFKYDT8 ports ScTabView SelectNextTab and SetTabNo sheet grouping from tabview3.cxx and SelectAllTables/DeselectAllTables from tabview2.cxx over real ScViewData/ScMarkData. Native WrapNextPrevSheetTab defaults true. Existing per-sheet cursor state survives navigation;normal selection retains a partial group on already-selected target sheets and collapses an all-selected group. Native Sfx slots26543,26544,26561,26562,26361,26365 use original operation/state boundaries. Navigation commits the real input draft first and rejected drafts prevent movement. Source group-only commands do not change model generation,dirty state or history. Shared CommandMenuBar executes real slots and browser Ctrl/Meta+PageUp/PageDown plus tab-arrow navigation use the same dispatcher. Hidden/alternate sheets,reference editing,drawing/window services and full native parity remain unported.

TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed.

TaskEJ2ZC1 replaces browser JSON equality gating with native input bModified lifecycle. Constructor false and source SetModified mark actual input;F2,focus and caret-only mode changes preserve the flag without writes. Accepted input uses native EnterHandler2 bOldMod guard;explicit replacement or changed-and-reverted text creates actual Undo even when final values are equal,as native SetNormalStringOperation does. Cancel,accepted input,history and model replacement reset modification;rejected drafts retain it. IsModified/ResetModified are explicit browser read/lifecycle projections of native private flag operations,not full upstream handlers. EditEngine,validation/autocorrect,format services and complete input/undo operation ownership remain unported.

TaskGBSSRW implements native ScTokenArray deep Clone with independent code tokens and first matching cloned code identity reused by RPN;RPN-only tokens clone separately,retaining represented flags and leaving native finalized default false. Same-document same-position ScFormulaCell copy/Clone retains cached result,dirty state and grammar,deep-copies code and follows native nonempty-error reset/recompile rule without starting listeners. Unsupported relocation/foreign-document/name/external/group/reference-adjustment services remain explicit. Represented destructor tracking/listener cleanup uses existing Dispose. Native ScCellValue now owns empty/numeric/shared-string/formula values,copies real borrowed/document content and commits cloned formulas;current plain literal text setter maps source SetString/setTextInput semantics without format services. Browser Undo owns actual ScCellValue before/after and releases through existing SfxUndoAction Dispose;the browser stored-cell union and token snapshot reconstruction are removed. Full EditEngine/rich text,clone relocation,clipboard/undo document modes,format services and whole Calc parity remain unported.

TaskBG0GG5 ports actual ScUndoSetCell maPos/maOldValue/maNewValue move ownership,represented SetValue,GetComment and getAffectedRange at native source/header boundaries. ScCellValue.release transfers real formulas without cloning and copies literal strings before clearing ownership. Shared SfxListUndoAction exposes native inherited SfxUndoArray.GetUndoAction forward-storage access. The browser current plain-input decoder prepares actual native cell/formula owners at each selected sheet position before writes;source selected-mark iteration uses existing EnterListAction/LeaveListAction so one user input creates one compound action. Undo reverses children,Redo forwards them;browser focus follows the last executed native affected range. Native selected sheets render Writer indigo/slate selection tokens while active state remains distinct. Full ScSimpleUndo,ScDocFunc/ScViewFunc,ScUndoEnterData raw-string redo,formatter/format attributes,change tracking,sheet views,spill/VCL services remain unported;no facade or injected fake provider is introduced.

TaskC5HB8X generates complete pinned sheettab.xml14commands/3separators and native PopupLabel/dialog-suffix projections through shared Writer parser/catalog tooling;451Calc commands remain source-hashed with11top menus and17explicit save-policy dispositions. Actual framework CommandPopupMenu is reused for pointer,ContextMenu and ShiftF10 with shared focus,disabled selection,outside dismissal and geometry. Source ScTabControl SwitchToPageId already-selected return preserves canonical active sheet/group;unselected requests commit supported input and select one target;blank-strip requests retain selection. Native ScInputHandler bFormulaMode/mbEditingExistingContent and StartsLikeFormula predicate distinguish new plus/minus/equals input from existing content. Explicit browser UpdateInputState/ResetInputState projections supply the actual draft/lifecycle without pretending to implement EditEngine or full UpdateFormulaMode. Formula/modal requests are rejected. Existing native SelectAll/Deselect slots execute;unported Insert/Remove/Rename/format/event services remain disabled. Full VCL TabBar current-page state,protection/reference highlighting,EditEngine and whole Calc parity remain unported.

TaskZXWXQ8 connects original no-argument SelectRow/SelectColumn slots26548/26547 to normal-grid ScTabView MarkRows/MarkColumns over actual ScViewData/ScMarkData. Existing simple selection endpoints expand to full axis extents;unmarked selection uses current normal cursor. Cursor and selected sheets remain;selection alone changes neither cells,dirty state nor history. Existing browser input owner commits or rejects pending drafts before selection and publishes real changes. Original ShiftSpace selects rows;column selection uses CtrlSpace on nonMac and AltSpace on Mac,only from the actual grid,not nested editors,composition or modal input. Actual shared Writer menus/resources/dispatch remain reused. Native reference-mode,end-block/window callbacks,parameterized Col/Row/Modifier automation and full native UI/core parity remain unverified.

TaskZXWXQ8 also projects the original InitBlockMode start to the existing browser anchor independently of the active cell,so subsequent shift extension uses the selected axis origin. No additional model or native window service is fabricated.

TaskWP2DC4 connects the actual shared Writer FontSizeSelect through Calc FontHeight slot10015 and ScFormatShell to real document/sheet/column/default-column ScAttrArray runs, ScPatternAttr and shared itemsets. Original height200twips100percent defaults and three-script font-size application are retained. Real ScUndoSelectionAttr stores an attribute-only ScDocument plus marks and redo delta; content remains in original cell stores. Automatic ODF cell styles preserve script font heights and styled empty row/column spans through actual package/autosave/open. ScDocumentPool exports only original contiguous character prefix100..124; no defaults are invented for unsupported cell/page items. Default fonts use source script-language fallbacks, shipped configuration and original no-device OnlyOne logical-family branch without claiming installed faces. Full native format/dialog/script-aware painting,automatic row height,named cell styles,family application and remaining cell/page defaults remain unverified. Writer visible-content/two-word naming,primary storage and no-recovery deviations remain. This leaf does not certify complete Calc UI parity.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser-owned lifecycle,input and viewport adaptation uses the same React/Tailwind visual controls as Writer.
